## metricsToPrometheus() function

Serializes a [MetricsStore](./gramstax.metricsstore.md) snapshot into Prometheus text format.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function metricsToPrometheus(snapshot: ReturnType<MetricsStore[`snapshot`]>, queueStats?: ITMetricsQueueStats | null): string;
```

string

Prometheus exposition text.

## Remarks

Emits `# HELP`<!-- -->/`# TYPE` headers, per-listener counters, per-counter cumulative totals, latency avg/max gauges, uptime, and optional queue stats. Zero-valued counters are skipped. Ends with a trailing newline.
